name: soak2h
description: Plan 11.4b: the D07 allocator comparison. Byte-for-byte the soak-s1-wan50 scenario - same S1 configuration, same wan50 netem, same churn/ping workloads, same seed - with the duration cut from six hours to two. Two hours is enough for what this run has to decide: the six-hour musl soak on lab-arm64 was already at 135 MB client RSS by the two-hour mark (62 MB at 15 min, +42 MB/h over the first two hours) against a 42 MB six-hour plateau on glibc, so a ratchet that exists will have separated the two builds several times over well inside the window. It is deliberately NOT a re-run of the acceptance soak: 11.4's acceptance criterion stays the six-hour pair. Acceptance here is the shape of the RSS curve - a plateau or a ramp - and whether the peak comes back after the traffic stops.
